messages:
harper: FYI — At ~03:10 UTC the interregion keystore unwrapping for apac->eu traffic started failing causing mTLS rejects on a small percentage of requests.
joel: Any RBAC changes around that time?
harper: We rolled a policy change to limit kms.decrypt for legacy rotators at 03:05 as part of least-privilege cleanup. Failures spiked at 03:11.
rina: Logs show KMS denied unwrap for svc/legacy-rotator@infra. Example: `rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt' denied for serviceAccount:svc/legacy-rotator@project`
security-oncall: Impact? dashboards show ~1.4% failed handshakes in APAC for 9m, small retry storms on internal queues, no external customer pages. treat as high-priority near-miss.
harper: Immediate mitigation: re-applied a temporary decrypt binding scoped to rotators, restarted rotator pool; handshakes normalized in ~5m.
joel: We should link KMS audit entries to rotator orchestration logs. Right now request IDs don't correlate.
audit-bot: Found 4 KMS Decrypt DENIED entries between 03:05:50-03:11:03 with ids: KMS-req-3b7a,KMS-req-3b7b,...
rina: Proposal: add `rotation_correlation_id` to rotator unwrap call and propagate to KMS request metadata and to proxy logs so we can trace a tls failure -> unwrap RPC.
harper: +1, add to runbook. Also add a preflight that validates the full chain and does an actual TLS handshake using rotated certs before marking rotation successful.
joel: I'll add a small go test to rotation controller and a CI gate: `openssl s_client -connect svc:443 -cert <rotated.pem> -key <rotated.key>` and an `openssl verify -CAfile` step.
security-oncall: Two policy items: 1) adopt staged RBAC migration (grant, verify, revoke); 2) require short overlap window when removing decrypt rights from rotators.
harper: We also spotted a handful of proxies allowing TLS1.2 for east-west. During unwrap flaps TLS renegotiation sometimes caused client retries to amplify. Recommend inventory + TLS1.3-only canary for internal.
joel: I'll generate inventory for apac and eu and propose a 5% canary in staging.
audit-bot: Request to increase KMS audit retention in apac from 30d -> 90d logged as KMS-APAC-AUD-90.
security-oncall: Also flag for vuln triage: if rotator error paths could expose key material or leak log entries with plaintext keys we need to scrub and review. Add CCA review to postmortem.
harper: Action items from thread:
- Implement rotation_correlation_id and propagate across rotator/KMS/proxy logs (harper)
- Add TLS preflight and openssl verify to rotation CI (joel)
- Update RBAC migration runbook to require staged grants with overlap window (security-oncall)
- Inventory services with tls_min_version < 1.3 and schedule canary (joel)
- Increase KMS audit retention for apac to 90d (security-oncall / ops)
- Run vuln triage on rotator logging paths to ensure no sensitive leakage (rina)

devops-bot: Temporary binding granted to svc/legacy-rotator until 2026-08-01T06:00Z to unblock. Ticket KMS-APAC-AUD-90 created.
security-oncall: I'll draft a short incident note and schedule a 30-min follow-up tomorrow to finalize runbook updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
